svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 实事求是 (traditional 實事求是), shí shì qiú shì, “Seek truth from facts”. Profile it. Don't guess where the time goes. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: Profile it. Don't guess where the time goes.
